prompts.title: Mini Avatar Collection
prompts.prompt:
Create a square 1:1 collage featuring six premium 3D chibi-style renders of the same subject, arranged in a clean 3-column × 2-row grid. The subject should be reusable for any person, so use the uploaded/reference person as the base subject and transform them into a cute stylized 3D chibi character while keeping the same subject identity consistent across all six panels.

The character should have a charming animated look with an oversized head, large glossy eyes, soft rounded facial features, rosy cheeks, a small nose, a warm smile, and thick fluffy hair adapted from the subject. Keep the same subject consistent in all six panels, while changing only the outfit, pose, and expression according to each scene below.

Use soft studio lighting, rich vivid smooth gradient backgrounds with clean saturated color depth, where the outer area stays more solid and colorful while the area near the subject becomes lighter and softer, subtle floor shadows, crisp fabric textures, detailed hair strands, and a clean high-resolution polished finish. Add a soft subtle rim light along the outer edges of the subject, especially around the hair, shoulders, arms, and clothing silhouette, so the character stays clearly separated from the background without looking overlit.

Panel 1 — Top Left:
A full-body subject standing calmly with both hands inside the hoodie pocket, gentle friendly smile, looking at the camera.
Outfit: olive green hoodie, dark charcoal jogger pants, white low-top sneakers, small pendant necklace and wrist bracelet.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with sky-blue as the more solid outer color, becoming a lighter warm peach glow near the subject.

Panel 2 — Top Middle:
A confident stylish subject standing with hands in pockets, one eye winking, cheerful smile.
Outfit: backward dark baseball cap, blue denim jacket, black-and-white striped t-shirt, black slim jeans with rolled cuffs, black-and-white sneakers, headphones resting around the neck, wristwatch.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with bright aqua-to-teal as the more solid outer color, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 3 — Top Right:
A joyful energetic subject laughing with eyes closed, both arms raised in celebration.
Outfit: bright yellow sweatshirt with bold “PLAY” text, loose black joggers, colorful sporty sneakers.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with warm golden yellow and coral pink as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 4 — Bottom Left:
A thoughtful subject standing in a cute thinking pose, one hand touching the chin, soft serious expression.
Outfit: dark bomber jacket, white graphic t-shirt, tan cargo pants, high-top black-and-white sneakers, small backpack straps visible.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with lavender and soft pink as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 5 — Bottom Middle:
A relaxed subject sitting on a small wooden stool, holding a smartphone in one hand, calm pleasant smile.
Outfit: cream oversized sweatshirt, soft blue joggers, clean white sneakers, subtle bracelets.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with pastel green and pale yellow as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Panel 6 — Bottom Right:
A cool fashionable subject standing with one hand in pocket and the other making a peace sign, confident playful smile.
Outfit: dark knit beanie, beige-and-black plaid overshirt over a black t-shirt, layered silver chain necklace, ripped black jeans, chunky sneakers, wristwatch and bracelet.
Background: a rich vivid gradient with blush pink and mint as the more solid outer colors, becoming lighter near the subject.

Overall style: ultra-clean premium 3D cartoon render, cute chibi proportions, detailed realistic clothing materials, expressive faces, smooth soft shading, polished cinematic character design, vibrant pastel color harmony, adorable social-media avatar aesthetic.

Premium 3D kawaii chibi sticker-sheet in a vertical 4:5 format. Clean 3x3 layout on a soft white-to-light-blue gradient. Each character must be a glossy die-cut sticker: thick rounded white border, subtle lifted paper edge, soft drop shadow, and high-quality toy-like 3D rendering.

Jumping (peace sign): Purple oversized top, sneakers.
Winking: Denim overalls, round glasses.
Heart hands: Soft pink dress.

Hugging bunny plush with closed eyes: Pink bunny pajamas, bunny slippers.

prompts.title: Enchanted First Dance
prompts.prompt:
A breathtaking 3D Disney-Pixar style caricature of a joyful couple celebrating their wedding. The style features exaggerated but expressive features, smooth skin textures, and a high-fidelity cinematic render typical of modern 3D animation.
Character Details & Outfits
The Woman: She has natural hair and a warm smile. She is looking at the man. She is wearing an intricate white lace long-sleeved wedding gown with a full, billowing skirt that catches the air as she twirls. Accessories include elegant white high heels and dangling diamond earrings.
The Man: He features a naturally stylishly hair. He is looking at the woman with a warm, adoring smile. He wears a sharp white tuxedo jacket with a black bow tie, black dress trousers, and polished black leather shoes.
Pose & Expression
The couple is captured in a dynamic dancing pose. The man has one hand placed gently on the woman's waist while holding her hand with the other as they twirl. Their expressions are filled with pure happiness and love, characterized by bright eyes and wide, genuine smiles.
Background & Setting
The scene is set in a lush, magical garden during sunset.
Floral Arch: A massive, semi-circular arch made of vibrant pink roses and white lilies frames the couple.
Atmosphere: Dozens of glowing golden lanterns hang from invisible trees in the background, creating a fairy-tale ambiance.
Elements: Multiple pink heart-shaped balloons float on either side, and the ground is covered in scattered pink flower petals.
Lighting & Atmosphere
Golden Hour: The primary light source is a soft, warm sunset in the background, creating a beautiful rim-light effect on the characters' hair and clothes.
Ambient Glow: Soft, warm light emanates from the hanging lanterns, casting gentle highlights and shadows.
Mood: The overall atmosphere is romantic, magical, and celebratory.
Composition & Camera Angle
Angle: Eye-level shot, capturing the full bodies of the couple to show the movement of the dress and their dancing stance.
Framing: Centered composition with the floral arch acting as a natural frame.
Depth of Field: Shallow depth of field, with the couple in sharp focus and the background lanterns and trees softly blurred (bokeh effect).
Technical Details
Resolution: 8k, Ultra-HD.
Render Engine: Octane Render, Unreal Engine 5 style.
Details: Ray tracing, global illumination, subsurface scattering on skin, high-resolution fabric textures (lace and silk).
Aspect Ratio: 4:5.

Subtle rim light on left side of hair and shoulder for separation. Bright, crisp eye catchlights.

8K ultra-detailed render, Unreal Engine 5 / Octane quality.

PBR materials, subsurface scattering for natural skin glow, high-resolution textures, sharp focus, clean premium color grading.

Stylized realism — no AI artifacts, no over-smoothing, no plastic skin.

prompts.title: The Modern Avatar
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity, 3D-rendered character portrait in the style of modern feature-film animation (such as Pixar or DreamWorks). Use the uploaded image only for facial reference to preserve identity while maintaining a polished, cinematic animated aesthetic.

Instruction (CRITICAL): Strictly IGNORE the pose details from the reference image.

Composition & Framing
The subject is positioned lower-right, as if peeking into view, with the chest up framing.
Ooccupies approximately 60–70% of the area in the frame, ensuring strong visual presence.
A head tilt for a friendly, approachable demeanour.
Pose should be natural.
Vertical aspect ratio (4:5).
Shallow depth of field with the subject in sharp focus and the background perfectly smooth.

Background
A seamless, ultra-smooth gradient with no texture or noise.

Diagonal color transition:
Deep magenta/pink in the upper left,
Vibrant orange in the center,
Bright golden-yellow in the lower right.
Soft, clean, and studio-like with a subtle bokeh-style finish.

Appearance & Expression
Stylized yet believable proportions typical of high-end animated films.
Warm, friendly, and charismatic expression with a subtle, confident smile.
Large, expressive eyes with natural catchlights.
Natural skin shading with realistic subsurface scattering for a lifelike appearance.
Expression should be natural.

Attire & Accessories
Modern, casual outfit (e.g, t-shirt, hoodie) with a clean, minimal design.
Contemporary eyewear with realistic reflections and refraction.
Physically accurate fabric textures with visible stitching and natural folds.

Lighting
Key Light: Soft, diffused light from the upper right, producing gentle highlights on the face.
Fill Light: Subtle illumination from the left to maintain balanced shadows and a friendly mood.
Global Illumination: Soft bounce lighting for realism.
Subsurface Scattering: Visible in the skin, especially around the ears and nose.
Soft reflections on accessories such as glasses.

Technical Specifications
High-end 3D CGI rendered using Physically Based Rendering (PBR).
Ultra-detailed textures with high-resolution normal and bump maps.
Clean topology and cinematic color grading.
Smooth anti-aliasing and studio-quality rendering.
8K resolution, ultra-sharp details.
Vibrant yet balanced color harmony.

Identity Constraint
Use the uploaded image strictly only for facial and identity reference.
Preserve facial structure, proportions, and likeness with high accuracy.
Do not alter ethnicity or introduce distortions.

Negative Prompt
Blurry, low resolution, noisy background, harsh shadows, flat lighting, distorted face, unnatural pose, exaggerated caricature, over-smoothing, plastic skin, dull colors, artifacts, incorrect anatomy, asymmetry, watermark, text, logo, cluttered background, grain, oversharpening.
